faculty.name: Paul R. Abramson
faculty.summary: Studies visual perception and attention in infants using eye-tracking methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究婴儿的视觉感知和注意力，使用眼动追踪方法。

faculty.name: Howard S. Adelman
faculty.summary: Studies policies and practices for addressing barriers to students' learning, focusing on system variables and intrinsic motivation.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究解决学生学习障碍的政策和实践，重点关注系统变量和内在动机。

faculty.name: Avi Adhikari
faculty.summary: Studies the neural circuits controlling fear and food-seeking in mice using optogenetics, calcium imaging, and behavioral assays.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究小鼠恐惧和觅食行为的神经回路，使用光遗传学、钙成像和行为测试技术。

faculty.name: Amber Ankowski
faculty.summary: Studies how children learn words from social cues, using eye-tracking and looking-time experiments with infants.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童如何通过社会线索学习词汇，使用婴儿的眼动追踪和注视时间实验。

faculty.name: Developmental Psychology
faculty.summary: Studies how infants learn words from social cues, using eye-tracking and looking-time experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究婴儿如何从社会线索中学习单词，使用眼动追踪和注视时间实验。

faculty.name: Carrie Bearden
faculty.summary: Studies early risk factors for developmental neuropsychiatric disorders, focusing on intermediate neurobehavioral traits and rare genetic disorders like 22q11.2 Deletion Syndrome.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究发育神经精神障碍的早期风险因素，重点关注中间神经行为特征和罕见的遗传疾病，如22q11.2缺失综合征。

faculty.name: Jackson Beatty
faculty.summary: Studies the large-scale structure of functional cortical cognitive circuits using neuroinformatic methods and computational models of competitive learning networks.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用神经信息学方法和竞争学习网络的计算模型研究功能性皮层认知回路的大规模结构。

faculty.name: Peter M. Bentler
faculty.summary: Studies personality, drug abuse, psychometrics, and causal modeling using quantitative methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人格、药物滥用、心理测量学以及因果建模的理论、方法和应用。

faculty.name: James Bisley
faculty.summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of visual attention and memory, using behavioral tasks and neurophysiological techniques with animals.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视觉注意力和记忆的神经机制，使用动物的行为任务和神经生理技术。

faculty.name: Cognitive Psychology
faculty.summary: Studies visual perception and attention using psychophysical methods and computational models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视觉感知和注意力，使用心理物理学方法和计算模型。

faculty.name: H. Tad Blair
faculty.summary: Studies how neural oscillators encode information and how learning alters neural activity to form memories in rats.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经振荡如何编码信息以及学习如何改变神经活动形成记忆的小鼠行为。

faculty.name: Aaron P. Blaisdell
faculty.summary: Studies how animals build and use representations of their world through conditioning and problem-solving tasks, focusing on causal inferences and rational behavior in rats and pigeons.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究动物如何通过条件反射和解决问题任务构建和使用其世界的表征，重点关注老鼠和鸽子的因果推理和理性行为。

faculty.name: Idan Blank
faculty.summary: Studies how we understand language, using neuroimaging and computational methods to explore the mental structures and processes involved in comprehension.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究语言理解的认知神经机制，使用神经成像和计算方法探讨理解语言时的心理结构和过程。

faculty.name: Erie Boorman
faculty.summary: Studies how the brain forms cognitive maps and uses them to make decisions and inferences, employing computational, behavioral, neuroimaging, and neurophysiological techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑如何形成认知地图并利用它们进行决策和推理，采用计算、行为、神经成像和神经生理学技术。

faculty.name: Julienne Bower
faculty.summary: Studies how positive psychological factors influence physical health in individuals with life-threatening illnesses, focusing on immune and neuroendocrine pathways.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究积极的心理因素如何影响患有致命疾病的个体的生理健康，重点关注免疫和神经内分泌途径。

faculty.name: Health Psychology
faculty.summary: Studies health behaviors and their psychological underpinnings, using visual and perceptual methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究健康行为及其心理基础，使用视觉和知觉方法。

faculty.name: Thomas N. Bradbury
faculty.summary: Studies the development of relationships and families, focusing on causes of adverse outcomes and interactional processes.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人际关系和发展家庭的成因，特别是不良结果的原因和互动过程。

faculty.name: Li Cai
faculty.summary: Develops statistical methods for item factor analysis and structural equation modeling.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发项目因数分析和结构方程模型的统计方法。

faculty.name: Bridget Callaghan
faculty.summary: Studies how early life experiences influence interactions between physical and mental health across the lifespan, using fMRI, microbiome, and physiology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究早期生活经历如何影响身心健康的相互作用，使用功能性磁共振成像、微生物组和生理学方法。

faculty.name: Alan Castel
faculty.summary: Studies how memory changes across the adult lifespan, focusing on selective memory and attentional processes.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究成年期记忆的变化，重点在于选择性记忆和注意过程。

faculty.name: Jaime Castrellon
faculty.summary: Studies how neural and behavioral factors influence motivation and decision-making, particularly in social and non-social contexts, using fMRI, PET, and computational models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经和行为因素如何影响动机和决策，特别是在社交和非社交情境中，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）、正电子发射断层扫描（PET）和计算模型。

faculty.name: Denise A. Chavira
faculty.summary: Develops and evaluates interventions for anxiety disorders in diverse populations, focusing on Latinos and rural youth.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发和评估针对焦虑障碍的干预措施，重点关注拉丁裔和农村青少年的心理健康服务研究。

faculty.name: Patricia Cheng
faculty.summary: Studies how humans form causal and empirical categories through cognitive experiments on adults and preschoolers, focusing on rationality and existential threats.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类如何通过认知实验形成因果和经验类别，重点关注理性与人类存在的威胁。

faculty.name: Bruce Chorpita
faculty.summary: Studies the effectiveness of mental health practices for children and adolescents, focusing on advancing current technologies.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童和青少年心理健康实践的有效性，致力于推进现有技术的发展。

faculty.name: Andrew Christensen
faculty.summary: Studies couples therapy, conflict resolution in relationships, and therapy outcomes.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究伴侣疗法、关系中的冲突解决以及治疗效果。

faculty.name: David Clewett
faculty.summary: Studies how physiological arousal influences memory formation and retrieval, using neuroimaging and behavioral methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究生理唤醒如何影响记忆的形成与检索，采用神经成像和行为学方法。

faculty.name: Michelle Craske
faculty.summary: Studies anxiety disorders and their treatments, focusing on cognitive and behavioral therapies.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究焦虑障碍及其治疗方法，侧重于认知和行为疗法。

faculty.name: Han Du
faculty.summary: Develops and applies Bayesian methods and statistical techniques in developmental, clinical, cognitive, educational, and health research.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发和应用贝叶斯方法和统计技术于发展、临床、认知、教育和健康研究。

faculty.name: Naomi Eisenberger
faculty.summary: Studies the neural basis of social rejection and connection, using neuroimaging techniques to understand how social relationships impact emotional and physical well-being.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会排斥和连接的神经基础，使用神经成像技术理解社会关系如何影响情绪和身体健康。

faculty.name: Craig Enders
faculty.summary: Develops methods for handling missing data in multilevel models, particularly using Bayesian estimation and multiple imputation.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发处理多级模型中缺失数据的方法，特别是使用贝叶斯估计和多重插补。

faculty.name: Chris Evans
faculty.summary: Studies the molecular, cellular, and behavioral effects of opioid drugs, focusing on striatal function and reward circuitry modulation.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究阿片类药物的分子、细胞和行为效应，重点关注纹状体功能和奖赏电路的调节。

faculty.name: Michael Fanselow
faculty.summary: Studies the nature and function of fear, focusing on forebrain regions and neurotransmitter systems using pharmacological manipulations and genetic modifications in rats and mice.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究恐惧的本质和功能，集中在前脑区域和神经递质系统，使用药理学操纵和基因修改在大鼠和小鼠中进行。

faculty.name: Yi Feng
faculty.summary: Develops advanced quantitative methods, particularly structural equation modeling, for psychology and education research.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发高级量化方法，特别是结构方程模型，应用于心理学和教育研究。

faculty.name: Iris Firstenberg
faculty.summary: Studies creativity and innovation in organizations, problem solving, and decision making.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究组织中的创造力和创新、问题解决和决策制定。

faculty.name: Craig Fox
faculty.summary: Studies judgment and decision making under risk and uncertainty, using surveys, experiments, and brain imaging.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究风险和不确定性下的判断与决策，使用调查、实验和脑成像方法。

faculty.name: Andrew Frane
faculty.summary: Studies musical and auditory perception, using statistical methodology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究音乐和听觉感知，采用统计方法。

faculty.name: Andrew J. Fuligni
faculty.summary: Studies how sociocultural experiences and biobehavioral factors influence adolescents' prosocial behavior and sleep patterns.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会文化经验与生物行为因素如何影响青少年的亲社会行为和睡眠模式。

faculty.name: Adriana Galván
faculty.summary: Studies how neurodevelopmental changes in cortical and striatal systems influence adolescent behaviors such as decision making and risk-taking, using brain imaging and behavioral methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究皮层和纹状体系统的神经发育变化如何影响青少年的行为，如决策和冒险行为，使用脑成像和行为方法。

faculty.name: Bonnie Goff
faculty.summary: Studies the neurobiological impacts of early adverse experiences on socio-emotional development, using insights into future mental health outcomes.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究早期不良经历对社会情绪发展的影响及其神经生物学机制，以预测未来的精神健康结果。

faculty.name: Noah Goldstein
faculty.summary: Studies how social norms influence behavior, using persuasion and conformity experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会规范如何影响行为，使用说服和从众实验。

faculty.name: Gerald M. Goodman
faculty.summary: Studies communication in close relationships and PTSD interventions, focusing on help-intended talk and companionship therapy.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究亲密关系中的沟通和PTSD干预，重点是求助意图言语和伴侣疗法。

faculty.name: Shulamite Green
faculty.summary: Studies neurobiological and physiological mechanisms of sensory processing difficulties in high-risk developmental populations, including autism and anxiety disorders, using neuroimaging and.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究高风险发展群体（包括自闭症和焦虑障碍）的感觉处理困难的神经生物学和生理学机制，使用神经成像和行为方法。

faculty.name: Patricia M. Greenfield
faculty.summary: Studies the impact of social change, cultural evolution, and communication technologies on human development, particularly among immigrant and first-generation college students.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会变迁、文化进化和通讯技术对人类发展的影响，特别是移民和第一代大学生。

faculty.name: Carlos V. Grijalva
faculty.summary: Studies the psychobiology of stress, behavior, and bodily diseases in animal models, focusing on brain and behavioral mechanisms of feeding and gastrointestinal functions.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究应激、行为和身体疾病的心理生物学机制，特别是在动物模型中的进食和消化功能的脑和行为机制。

faculty.name: William Grisham
faculty.summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of behavior in modular digital courseware for undergraduate neuroscience education.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究行为的神经机制，并开发模块化数字课程ware以用于本科神经科学教育。

faculty.name: Constance Hammen
faculty.summary: Studies how stress affects mental health, using longitudinal studies and daily diaries.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究压力对心理健康的影响，使用纵向研究和日常日记的方法。

faculty.name: Jesse Harris
faculty.summary: Studies how different sources of information are integrated during sentence processing, using real-time response methods and eye-tracking.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究不同信息来源在句子处理中的整合，使用实时反应方法和眼动追踪技术。

faculty.name: Martie Haselton
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive biases in communication, intimate relationships, and the effects of reproductive hormones on human behavior.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究沟通中的认知偏差、亲密关系以及生殖激素对人类行为的影响。

faculty.name: Hal Hershfield
faculty.summary: Studies how people consider their future selves and how this impacts financial and well-being decisions.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人们如何考虑未来自我以及这种考虑如何影响财务和幸福感决策。

faculty.name: Tiffany Ho
faculty.summary: Studies how brain circuits underlying thoughts, emotions, and behaviors change during adolescent development, focusing on stress and depression.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究青少年时期大脑电路如何随思维、情感和行为的变化而变化，重点关注压力和抑郁症。

faculty.name: Eric W. Holman
faculty.summary: Studies how statistical properties of classifications reflect psychological processes and the nature of classified items.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究分类的统计特性如何反映分类者的心理过程以及分类对象的性质。

faculty.name: Keith Holyoak
faculty.summary: Studies how analogy and relational knowledge influence reasoning, learning, and decision-making using computational modeling and neuroimaging.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究类比和关系知识如何影响推理、学习和决策，并使用计算建模和神经成像进行研究。

faculty.name: Yuen J. Huo
faculty.summary: Studies how social identity needs and experiences with fairness affect social interactions and intergroup cooperation, particularly in diverse communities.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会身份需求和公平体验如何影响社交互动和跨群体合作，特别是在多元化社区中。

faculty.name: Alicia Izquierdo
faculty.summary: Studies the brain mechanisms of flexible reinforcement learning and value-based decisions using behavioral, molecular, pharmacological, computational, and in vivo imaging methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究灵活的强化学习和基于价值的决策的脑机制，使用行为学、分子生物学、药理学、计算建模和体内成像方法。

faculty.name: Kerri Johnson
faculty.summary: Studies how people perceive and categorize others based on physical appearance, using various methods including experiments with children and adults.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人们如何根据外貌对他人进行分类和感知，使用包括儿童和成人实验在内的多种方法。

faculty.name: Scott Johnson
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive and perceptual development, using computational modeling and neurophysiological methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知和知觉发展，使用计算建模和神经生理学方法。

faculty.name: Katherine H. Karlsgodt
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive changes in neuropsychiatric disorders using fMRI, DTI, and behavioral testing in humans and animal models.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用功能性磁共振成像(fMRI)、扩散张量成像(DTI)和行为测试研究神经精神障碍中的认知变化，涉及人类和动物模型。

faculty.name: Benjamin Karney
faculty.summary: Studies how external stress affects relationship maintenance in newlywed couples, using longitudinal data and observational methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究外部压力如何影响新婚夫妇关系的维持，使用纵向数据和观察方法。

faculty.name: Phil Kellman
faculty.summary: Studies how visual perception of objects, contours, and shapes works, using deep networks and perceptual learning.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视觉对象、轮廓和形状的感知机制，使用深度网络和知觉学习方法。

faculty.name: Barbara Knowlton
faculty.summary: Studies the neural bases of memory using neuroimaging and neuropsychological testing.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究记忆的神经基础，使用神经成像和神经心理学测试方法。

faculty.name: Ian Krajbich
faculty.summary: Studies how people make decisions by evaluating options over time, using choice-process measures like response times and eye tracking.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人们如何通过时间评估选项来做决策，使用反应时间、眼动追踪等选择过程指标。

faculty.name: Franklin B. Krasne
faculty.summary: Studies invertebrate neurophysiology, focusing on physiological psychology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究无脊椎动物神经生理学，侧重于生理心理学。

faculty.name: Jaimie Arona Krems
faculty.summary: Studies how humans form and maintain friendships, addressing challenges like finding and keeping friends, and how women navigate social relationships.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类如何建立和维持友谊，探讨寻找和保持朋友时面临的挑战，以及女性如何在社交关系中导航。

faculty.name: Anna S. Lau
faculty.summary: Studies how infants learn words from social cues, using eye-tracking and looking-time experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究婴儿如何通过社会线索学习单词，使用眼动追踪和注视时间实验。

faculty.name: Stephanie Leal
faculty.summary: Studies how memory works and how it is affected in disorders like Alzheimer’s disease and depression, using imaging techniques and cognitive tasks.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究记忆的工作机制及其在阿尔茨海默病和抑郁症等疾病中的异常，使用成像技术和认知任务。

faculty.name: Steve S. Lee
faculty.summary: Studies the origins, development, and outcomes of ADHD and disruptive behavior disorders in children, focusing on risk factors, causal mechanisms, and sex differences.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究注意力缺陷多动障碍和破坏性行为障碍的起源、发展和结果，重点关注风险因素、因果机制和性别差异。

faculty.name: Matthew Lieberman
faculty.summary: Studies the neural bases of social interactions and consciousness using fNIRS, focusing on friendship, ideological conflict, and team performance.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会互动和意识的神经基础，使用功能性近红外光谱成像技术（fNIRS），关注友谊、意识形态冲突和团队表现。

faculty.name: Falk Lieder
faculty.summary: Studies moral learning and decision-making using computational modeling and experiments, aiming to improve societal decision-making.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究道德学习和决策制定，使用计算建模和实验方法，旨在改善社会决策。

faculty.name: Zili Liu
faculty.summary: Studies how our perceptual representation of the world differs from reality, focusing on 3D motion and shape perception, perceptual learning, and computational modeling.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究我们对世界的知觉表征与现实之间的差异，重点关注三维运动和形状知觉、知觉学习和计算建模。

faculty.name: Hongjing Lu
faculty.summary: Studies how humans learn and reason, focusing on action recognition, object recognition, causal reasoning, and analogical reasoning.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类学习和推理的方式，重点关注动作识别、物体识别、因果推理和类比推理。

faculty.name: Vickie M. Mays
faculty.summary: Studies mental and physical health disparities among racial and ethnic minority populations, focusing on discrimination, HIV/AIDS, and mental health services.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究种族和 Ethnic 少数群体的心理和身体健康差异，重点关注歧视、艾滋病和心理健康服务。

faculty.name: Sean McAuliffe
faculty.summary: Studies visual perception and attention using eye-tracking methods with adults.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视觉感知和注意力，使用眼动追踪方法与成人。

faculty.name: Jocelyn Meza
faculty.summary: Studies the development of suicide and self-harming behaviors in youth, focusing on structurally marginalized populations and adapting interventions.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究青年自杀和自伤行为的发展，重点关注结构化边缘化群体，并适应干预措施。

faculty.name: David J. Miklowitz
faculty.summary: Studies the treatment and prevention of bipolar disorder in adolescents, using family therapy.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究青少年双相障碍的治疗方法和预防措施，采用家庭疗法。

faculty.name: Martin M. Monti
faculty.summary: Studies the relationship between language and thought, and consciousness in patients with severe brain injuries, using fMRI and behavioral tools.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究语言与思维之间的关系以及严重脑损伤患者的意识状态，使用功能性磁共振成像(fMRI)和行为工具。

faculty.name: Amanda Kay Montoya
faculty.summary: Develops statistical methods and tools to improve research practices in psychology, focusing on mediation, moderation, and structural equation modeling.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发统计方法和工具以改善心理学研究实践，重点关注中介、调节和结构方程建模。

faculty.name: Virginia Sklar Muscatello
faculty.summary: Studies educational practices and research methods to support equitable and evidence-based teaching and learning in psychology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究教育实践和研究方法，以支持心理学中的公平和基于证据的教学和学习。

faculty.name: Carolyn Murray
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive processes in infants using eye-tracking and looking-time experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究婴儿的认知过程，使用眼动追踪和注视时间实验。

faculty.name: Lauren C. Ng
faculty.summary: Develops and implements evidence-based interventions for underserved communities affected by trauma, focusing on posttraumatic stress disorder in Rwanda and Ethiopia.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发和实施针对受创伤影响的边缘化社区的基于证据的干预措施，重点关注卢旺达和埃塞俄比亚的创伤后应激障碍。

faculty.name: Keith H. Nuechterlein
faculty.summary: Studies clinical psychology, focusing on therapy and assessment.
faculty.summary_zh: 从事临床心理学研究，专注于治疗和评估。

faculty.name: Carolyn Parkinson
faculty.summary: Studies how the human brain represents and navigates social networks and the cognitive and behavioral consequences of social network structure.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类大脑如何表示和导航社交网络及其结构对认知和行为的影响。

faculty.name: Letitia Anne Peplau
faculty.summary: Studies close relationships, gender issues, and gay and lesbian relationships and identity.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究亲密关系、性别问题以及同性恋和双性恋关系和身份。

faculty.name: Efrén Pérez
faculty.summary: Studies the influence of language on political thinking and attitudes, using implicit cognition measures and surveys.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究语言对政治思维和态度的影响，使用隐性认知测量和调查方法。

faculty.name: Lara Ray
faculty.summary: Studies the mechanisms of risk and treatment response for substance use disorders, integrating clinical psychology, pharmacology, and neuroscience.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究物质使用障碍的风险机制和治疗反应，结合临床心理学、药理学和神经科学的方法。

faculty.name: Dario Ringach
faculty.summary: Studies visual psychophysics and electrophysiology to understand how the brain processes visual information.

faculty.name: Sotiris Masmanidis
faculty.summary: Studies the neurobiological basis of reward-guided learning and movement, focusing on Parkinson's disease models and striatal roles.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究奖励导向学习和运动的神经生物学基础，重点关注帕金森病模型和纹状体的作用。

faculty.name: Nicolas Massaly
faculty.summary: Studies various neuroscience topics as indicated by publication fields.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经科学领域的多种主题，具体领域由出版物的期刊分类决定。

faculty.name: Paul Mathews
faculty.summary: Studies how the cerebellum and forebrain communicate to influence behavior, learning, and social behavior, using electrophysiology, neuroanatomy, and targeted cell manipulation.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究小脑和前脑之间的交流如何影响行为、学习和社会行为，使用电生理学、神经解剖学和特定细胞操纵的方法。

faculty.name: John Mazziotta
faculty.summary: Studies brain imaging and neural reactivity to emotional faces, using MRI and other imaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑成像和对情绪面孔的神经反应，使用MRI和其他成像技术。

faculty.name: Mayank Mehta
faculty.summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and memory using computational models and electrophysiology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆的神经机制，使用计算模型和电生理学方法。

faculty.name: Adys Mendizabal
faculty.summary: Studies social and structural determinants of health, particularly in Huntington’s Disease and adverse childhood experiences, using neuroimaging and cognitive methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会和结构性因素对健康的影响，特别是在亨廷顿舞蹈症和不良童年经历中的神经影像学和认知方法。

faculty.name: Martin Monti
faculty.summary: Studies the neural basis of consciousness and its disorders, using techniques like transcranial focused ultrasound and brain assembloids.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究意识和意识障碍的神经基础，使用跨颅聚焦超声和脑类器官等技术。

faculty.name: Katherine Narr
faculty.summary: Studies the effects of electroconvulsive therapy on brain structure and function in depression, and the impact of prenatal alcohol and tobacco exposure on cognitive development.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究电抽搐治疗对抑郁症脑结构和功能的影响，以及孕期酒精和烟草暴露对认知发展的影响。

faculty.name: Bennett Novitch
faculty.summary: Investigates brain mechanisms of addiction and mental health, using multiple NIH-funded projects.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究成瘾和心理健康的大脑机制，使用多个NIH资助的项目。

faculty.name: Erika Nurmi
faculty.summary: Studies brain structure alterations in obsessive-compulsive disorder using neuroimaging and transcriptomic analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究强迫症的脑结构改变，使用神经影像学和转录组分析。

faculty.name: Roel Ophoff
faculty.summary: Studies genetic contributors to schizophrenia and Alzheimer's disease using large-scale genetic and proteomic data.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究精神分裂症和阿尔茨海默病的遗传贡献，使用大规模遗传和蛋白质组学数据。

faculty.name: Kete Paul
faculty.summary: Studies sleep regulatory mechanisms in the context of neuroendocrinology and sex differences.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究睡眠调节机制及其在神经内分泌学和性别差异中的作用。

faculty.name: Chao Peng
faculty.summary: Studies various neuroscience topics as classified by the National Library of Medicine.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经科学领域，分类由美国国家医学图书馆确定。

faculty.name: Yi-Rong Peng
faculty.summary: Studies various fields of neuroscience as classified by the National Library of Medicine.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究美国国家医学图书馆分类的各类神经科学领域。

faculty.name: Patricia Phelps
faculty.summary: Studies various neuroscience topics as indicated by publication fields.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经科学领域的多种课题，具体主题由发表论文的期刊分类决定。

faculty.name: Gina Poe
faculty.summary: Studies how sleep affects learning and memory consolidation, using synapses, cells, and circuits.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究睡眠如何影响学习和记忆巩固，使用突触、细胞和电路的方法。

faculty.name: Carlos Portera-Cailliau
faculty.summary: Studies neural mechanisms of movement disorders, particularly Parkinson's disease, using animal models and electrophysiology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究运动障碍，特别是帕金森病的神经机制，使用动物模型和电生理学方法。

faculty.name: Mayumi Lynn Prins
faculty.summary: Studies neural mechanisms of working memory using neuroimaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究工作记忆的神经机制，使用神经成像技术。

faculty.name: Jessica Rexach
faculty.summary: Studies Alzheimer's disease mechanisms, using NIH-funded research.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究阿尔茨海默病机制，使用NIH资助的研究。

faculty.name: Barney Schlinger
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive and neural mechanisms of memory and learning, using NIH-funded research.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究记忆和学习的认知和神经机制，使用NIH资助的研究。

faculty.name: Felix Schweizer
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive and neural mechanisms of memory and learning, using various NIH-funded projects.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究记忆和学习的认知和神经机制，使用多种NIH资助的项目。

faculty.name: Pavak Shah
faculty.summary: Studies neural mechanisms of social cognition and communication, using neuroimaging and behavioral experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会认知和交流的神经机制，使用神经成像和行为实验方法。

faculty.name: Kalyanam Shivkumar
faculty.summary: Studies the mechanisms of human cardiac arrhythmias, focusing on the role of the autonomic nervous system and developing non-pharmacologic therapies.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类心律失常的机制，特别是自主神经系统的作用，并开发非药物治疗方法。

faculty.name: Desmond Smith
faculty.summary: Studies genetic and molecular mechanisms of neurodevelopmental disorders, using NIH-funded research.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经发育障碍的遗传和分子机制，使用NIH资助的研究。

faculty.name: Igor Spigelman
faculty.summary: Studies the effects of cannabinoids on pain and nociception in mice, using mouse models and bioRxiv preprints.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大麻素对疼痛和感觉神经元的影响，使用小鼠模型和bioRxiv预印本。

faculty.name: Joshua Trachtenberg
faculty.summary: Studies how early sensory experiences shape synaptic connections in the visual cortex, affecting neural circuit function and behavior.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究早期感官经验如何塑造视觉皮层的突触连接，影响神经网络功能和行为。

faculty.name: Michael Wells
faculty.summary: Studies the foundations of human brain diversity and the mechanisms of neurodevelopmental disorders like autism and intellectual disability.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类大脑多样性的基础以及神经发育障碍如自闭症和智力障碍的机制。

faculty.name: Stephanie White
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive and neural mechanisms of memory and learning, using various NIH-funded projects.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究记忆和学习的认知和神经机制，使用多种NIH资助的项目。

faculty.name: Roger Woods
faculty.summary: Studies the effects of prenatal alcohol and tobacco exposure on brain structure and cognitive outcomes, using neuroimaging and clinical trials.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究孕期酒精和烟草暴露对大脑结构和认知结果的影响，使用神经影像学和临床试验。

faculty.name: William Zeiger
faculty.summary: Investigates cortical circuit dysfunction in neurological disorders, particularly Parkinson disease.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经疾病中的皮层电路功能障碍，尤其是帕金森病。

faculty.name: Ye Zhang
faculty.summary: Studies glial cells in health and disease, using NIH-funded research.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究健康和疾病中的胶质细胞，使用NIH资助的研究。

faculty.name: Jie J. Zheng
faculty.summary: Studies molecular and genetic mechanisms of cognitive functions, using NIH-funded research.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知功能的分子和遗传机制，使用NIH资助的研究。

faculty.name: Larry S. Zipursky
faculty.summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and memory, focusing on molecular and cellular processes.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆的神经机制，侧重于分子和细胞过程。
